cases.subject: receipt-before-root-inspection
cases.method: offline cargo build without Phase-B receipt and a deliberately invalid runtime-root value
cases.expected: build fails before runtime-root parsing or probing
cases.observed: LIFEOS_RUNTIME_ROOT rejected before build output: phase_b_independent_pass_required before runtime-root inspection

cases.subject: 20 IPC and provider-lock contract
cases.method: independent Rust harness plus source inventory
cases.expected: exactly 20 IPC; OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama/LM Studio only; Custom rejected; first send locks settings; no fallback or parallel dispatch
cases.observed: 20 IPC static inventory passed; four provider profiles accepted; Custom deserialization rejected; attempted post-send switch returned provider_locked_after_first_send

cases.subject: Work 7-14 days and restart safety
cases.expected: at most one Work per day and at most 14 total; day-two and fifteenth insertions reject before write; owned restart writes/sends no duplicate
cases.observed: daily_work_limit_rejected and input_limit_rejected; fresh owned-root restart preserved one capture/day without duplicate

cases.subject: five-field structured non-medical Health
cases.method: 480 legal enum/energy combinations plus invalid payloads
cases.expected: all legal values and energy 1-5 persist; missing/invalid/free_text reject before write; UI/SQLite/Today/feedback remain consistent
cases.observed: 480 legal combinations accepted; energy 0, unknown enum, extra free_text and missing fields returned health_schema_rejected before write; Today/feedback controlled flow passed. But the exact real-mode Today UI payload uses source:local:user-confirmed while receipt-enabled fixture mode requires source:synthetic:controlled-fixture, so it returned source_refs_rejected before write.

cases.subject: confirmed Durable Memory limit
cases.expected: three confirmed items maximum; fourth rejects before write and remains rejected after restart
cases.observed: fourth returned durable_memory_limit_rejected; persisted count remained three across restart

cases.subject: runtime-root shapes and ownership
cases.method: fresh missing root and eight negative shapes
cases.expected: only fresh missing root succeeds; empty/file/link/ancestor-link/unowned DB/unknown/sidecar/noncanonical reject
cases.observed: real_root_ownership_missing, runtime_root_type_rejected, path_symlink_rejected, runtime_root_noncanonical, real_root_not_empty and database_sidecar_rejected observed on their respective negative paths

cases.subject: Today, feedback, Context Resolver and budget fail-closed
cases.method: controlled P3-140-compatible Today request and direct resolver request
cases.expected: correct feedback stales one result and persists one feedback; over-budget error has no state mutation
cases.observed: one stale result and one feedback persisted; both Today fault and 31-token resolver request returned context_budget_rejected with before/after counts unchanged

cases.subject: real external provider dispatch
cases.observed: real Provider, credentials and network were explicitly prohibited; no external dispatch was attempted

overall: most contract-permitted controlled dynamic checks passed. Two P0 failures remain: actual-Tauri startup receipt geometry is stale, and the actual Today Health UI payload is rejected in the receipt-enabled controlled fixture mode.
